decisions.reason: The existing message-158 MODIFY already updates the About page's prize-draw copy to one $500 winner every 100 sales and one $10,000 winner every 10,000 sales.
The existing message-158 MODIFY already updates both FAQ prize descriptions with the new winner counts and sales intervals.
The existing message-158 MODIFY fully captures the changed Big Block winner count, 10,000-sale trigger, and exact interval; the $10,000 amount remains unchanged.
The existing message-158 MODIFY fully captures the changed Small Block winner count, $500 pool target, 100-sale interval, and exact interval; the per-winner amount remains unchanged.
Changing prize counts and draw frequency does not change the Chainlink VRF selection method, eligible ticket-weighted population, or verification behavior.
The source changes only Small and Big Block prize parameters and does not change the $5 referral commission or its payout behavior.
The source changes prize counts and draw intervals but does not resolve or alter whether prizes are automatically delivered or manually claimed.
The Small and Big Block ticket counters and permanent badges remain valid metadata fields despite the changed prize counts and draw intervals.
The prize-parameter adjustment does not change the current or planned product names.
Message 158 changes prize counts and frequency while preserving the net giveaway amount; it does not itself remove or modify Aave yield integration.
Both prize pools remain active destinations, and the source does not change the mint price, commission, founder share, or per-sale allocation.
Changing prize counts and draw intervals does not alter transfer of active or expired tickets, badges, referral identity, or book entitlement on resale.
